config_dir.description: Path to the directory where nvpy stores its local cache of notes and metadata.

server_url.description: The base URL of the Simplenote API server to connect to.

username.description: The Simplenote account username used for authentication.

password.description: The Simplenote account password or API key used for authentication.

auto_sync.description: Whether to automatically sync notes with the Simplenote server in the background.

sync_interval.description: The number of seconds to wait between automatic syncs when auto_sync is enabled.

markdown_enabled.description: Whether to render and display markdown syntax in the note viewer.

tags_to_show.description: A list of specific tag names to filter which notes are displayed. If empty, all notes are shown.
